card.text: Young star 146 parsecs away in Ophiuchus, one of a close pair with a giant planet photographed far out.

introduction.text: ROXs 42B A and B are young stars 11 au apart, circling each other every 31 years. Their planet b lies about 150 au out.

color.title: Photosphere colour
color.summary: A blackbody at the star's published temperature. No surface picture exists.
